nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are the most frequent commenters and mostly report the serum is gentle enough for daily or near-daily use without irritation, though one reviewer developed itchy red bumps and stopped use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum feels moisturizing rather than drying, with one noting her skin runs dry and never oily and finds this formula more moisturizing than a stronger retinol from the same brand.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination-to-oily, sensitive, clog-prone skin reports smoother skin and no new pimples after switching from prescription tretinoin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s describe smoother texture and a softening of forehead lines and deep-set wrinkles with continued use.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers report smoother texture, smaller-looking pores, and a visible softening of fine lines and forehead wrinkles within two to six weeks of nightly or every-other-night use; a few see no meaningful change even after a month.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal acne report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, including some who say it succeeded where prescription retinoids failed; a handful describe an initial purging period of small breakouts before skin clears, and one reviewer developed itchy red bumps across the face and neck.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers commonly describe mild, temporary dryness or peeling when starting out, especially around the mouth, that eases with a moisturizer or a slower introduction schedule; most who stick with a gradual routine report the serum feels moisturizing rather than drying.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness concerns report no additional redness or itchiness from the serum and some note their redness improved, though the one reviewer who reacted badly describes itchy red bumps across the face.

aspects.libelle: Opaque bottle hides how much product is left
Pricey but a little goes a long way
Interior bottle capacity smaller than the advertised volume

extraits.texte: Not a fan. Except for adding this to my skincare regime, nothing else has changed and I've broken out into small, itchy, red bumps all over my face and the side of neck. I reached out to Kiehls via email but yet to hear back.

extraits.titre: Start slow if your skin is sensitive
extraits.texte: My skin is a little sensitive. If you do, you migh want to use tjis once a day or every other day and increase slowly over time. I have been using the Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel and the Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide twice a day. I appreciate these free sample. After about a week and a half my skin seemed a bit smoother and I had not had any irritation. After a couple more days, my skin became irritated. After a little break, I plan to just use one in the morning and the other at night and skip using either once a week. I am hopeful that with longer term use I will see more results since the active ingredients have been shown effective in skin care.

I have not had great experiences with retinol in the past. I have dry sensitive skin. This product seems to be giving me results without excessive side effects. I am noticing a slight reduction in fine lines. The dryness is minimal. I will continue using.

I began with this retinol, and moved on to the stronger variation by Dr.Kiehls. I ended up coming back to this product. It keeps my acne cleared up almost completely. My skin has not been this clear in about 10 years (when a certain medication caused breakouts that continued after discontinuing those meds). I get one or two pimples at a time now if even. I never get painful zits now like I did before this product. My skin is very sensitive. I can only introduce one product at a time. My skin is more dry and never oily. I prefer this retinol because it is more moisturizing and my skin glows. The stronger retinol by Kiehls smells funky and did not reduce my 11 lines as promised. My deepset forhead wrinkles have not gone away with either, but maybe a small redux. Im 27 and my wrinkles are not that bad, but they exist. I think this retinol is better than their stronger one for me. I stay with this retinol because it clears my skin, keeps it moisturized, and looks like it plumpens my skin abd possibly reduced the appearance of wrinkles when paired with my cream and hyalornic acid.

I received Kiehl's potent retinol serum complimentary from BzzAgent and Kiehl's in exchange for my honest review. I've been a little scared of retinol even though I know it's time to start using it. This serum is a great way to ease into the benefits of a retinol! It mixes a daily strength retinol with Ceramides and Peptide to promote gentle skin turnover. I have rosacea and this has not caused any additional redness or itchiness which I appreciate. I used this in conjunction with the triple acid peel and I'm excited to see the benefits. Highly recommend

extraits.titre: Nice gentle retinol to start out with
extraits.texte: I have combo to oily sensitive skin, with clogged pores being an issue. I've used prescription tretinoin but found it to be too rough for my skin. This does produce a feeling of smoother skin, but without the redness the next day. No pimples from this product either.
